module_summary: Serial byte-framing FSM: a 12-state machine detects a start bit, steps through 8 data bits, checks the stop bit and flags done or error.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Framing FSM register: START, B0-B7, STOP, DONE, ERR; decoded to done.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Asserted when FSM is in DONE state after a valid stop bit.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Serial bit stream; steers start, stop and error transitions.

groups.name: Framing controller
groups.description: Next-state logic and state register for start/data/stop framing; done decode.
